name: Vitrake ex

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
flavorText: Two quiet horns. One unmistakable warning.
system: Physical Pokémon TCG; custom fan card, not tournament legal or Pokémon TCG Pocket.
designNotes: Dragon is the Pokémon type. There is no Basic Dragon Energy; Fire and Water costs echo the two reservoirs.
Colorless costs can be paid by any Energy type. Attacking does not normally discard attached Energy.
Modern Dragon cards commonly have no Weakness or Resistance. They do not inherit the video-game type chart.
This is an ordinary Pokémon ex, not a Mega Evolution. The premium full-art/foil treatment is cosmetic.
Attack values and assignment are fan design. No playtesting claim; conservative comparator-based starting point.
